name: embedding_memory
description: A semantic text memory that stores one text as a local embedding chunk and retrieves the most similar chunks for a query sentence. Provide text to store, or query to retrieve stored chunks only. Persistent across restarts.

reason.description: Why you call this tool (max 15 words, English).

text.description: Text to store as one embedding chunk (max 2000 chars). Provide this to store.

query.description: Sentence that retrieves stored embedding chunks only. Provide this to search.

top_k.description: How many chunks to return (1-10, default 5). For search only.
